root_cause.text: The soft reset sequence is executed from the threaded IRQ handler, and it calls disable_irq() which synchronously waits for all IRQ handlers to complete, including itself, causing a deadlock.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states, "The soft reset sequence is currently executed from the threaded IRQ handler, hence it cannot call disable_irq() which internally waits for IRQ handlers, i.e. itself, to complete." The patch replaces disable_irq() with disable_irq_nosync() during soft reset, and the added comment explains that the code cannot (nor needs to) wait for any IRQ processing to complete.
